name: Mǎo Dragon
biography: Dracopia luna. The zodiac dragon of the rabbit — a moonlit healer that turns ethereal when wounded and whose lucky number 4 spills restorative light over its allies. Habitat: Forest & Grassland.

features.name: Ascendant Form
features.description: While the dragon is Bloodied, it emits moonlight, which is Dim Light, in a 30-foot Emanation, and the dragon becomes translucent and ethereal, causing attack rolls made against it to have Disadvantage.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
features.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Lucky Number
features.description: Whenever the dragon rolls a 4 on a d12, it and creatures of its choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the dragon regain 9 (2d8) Hit Points.

features.name: Tail
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Radiant damage.

features.name: Healer's Light
features.description: The dragon bathes one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself in moonlight, restoring 13 (2d12) Hit Points to it.

features.name: Evoke Hope
features.description: The dragon magnifies the hope of another creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. Whenever damage would reduce the creature to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Charisma saving throw (DC 15 or equal to the damage taken, whichever is higher). On a successful save, the creature is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead. This benefit lasts for 1 hour, until the dragon or target becomes Incapacitated, or until the dragon takes this Bonus Action again.

features.name: Full Moon (Legendary Action)
features.description:
Legendary Action Uses: 1. Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

The dragon dispels all Illusion spells within 30 feet of itself of level 3 or lower.

features.name: New Moon (Legendary Action)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 14 Wisdom, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. Failure: 6 (1d12) Radiant damage, and the target is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Rush (Legendary Action)
features.description: The dragon moves up to its Speed and makes one Tail attack.
